description: This file defines a centralized API client for a Next.js frontend, including functions for making API requests, handling errors, and specific API endpoints related to orchestration, personas, documents, and uploads.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling API response errors with status and payload.

methods.name: apiFetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with automatic JSON handling, error throwing on non-2xx responses, and URL resolution based on environment.

methods.name: orchestrationRunAll
methods.description: Initiates an orchestration process via POST request to /api/orchestration/run-all.

methods.name: getBuildStatus
methods.description: Fetches the status of a build by its ID.

methods.name: extractNormalizeForBuild
methods.description: Requests normalization of build data via POST to /api/orchestration/builds/{id}/extract-normalize.

methods.name: generateDraftForBuild
methods.description: Generates a draft persona for a build via POST to /api/orchestration/builds/{id}/generate-draft.

methods.name: finalizePersonaForBuild
methods.description: Finalizes a persona for a build via POST to /api/orchestration/builds/{id}/finalize.

methods.name: getOrchestrationByBuild
methods.description: Retrieves orchestration details for a specific build.

methods.name: updatePersona
methods.description: Updates persona metadata and optional JSON data via PUT to /api/personas/{id}.

methods.name: savePersonaDraftLatest
methods.description: Saves the latest draft JSON for a persona via PUT to /api/personas/{id}/draft/latest.

methods.name: getLatestPersonaFinalArtifact
methods.description: Loads the latest finalized persona artifact via GET /api/personas/{id}/final/latest.

methods.name: listDocuments
methods.description: Lists document metadata via GET /api/documents with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: uploadDocuments
methods.description: Uploads documents via multipart/form-data POST to /api/uploads/documents.

methods.name: uploadDocumentsWithProgress
methods.description: Uploads documents with progress callback support using XMLHttpRequest.
